from collections import deque
def find_clusters(grid, val):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    visited = set()
    clusters = []
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if grid[i][j] == val and (i,j) not in visited:
                cluster = []
                q = deque([(i,j)])
                visited.add((i,j))
                while q:
                    ci, cj = q.popleft()
                    cluster.append((ci, cj))
                    for ni, nj in [(ci+1,cj),(ci-1,cj),(ci,cj+1),(ci,cj-1)]:
                        if 0 <= ni < h and 0 <= nj < w and grid[ni][nj] == val and (ni,nj) not in visited:
                            visited.add((ni,nj))
                            q.append((ni,nj))
                clusters.append(cluster)
    return clusters
